SuitDesc.SourceString: 全队攻击带有「赤焰」的目标时，回复3点充能值，此效果冷却时间为1秒。
SuitDesc.LocalizedString: Restores 3 Charge when allies attack a target with Crimson Flame. Cooldown: 1s.

SuitDesc.SourceString: 全队攻击带有「赤焰」的目标时，回复6点充能值，此效果冷却时间为1秒。
SuitDesc.LocalizedString: Restores 6 Charge when allies attack a target with Crimson Flame. Cooldown: 1s.

SuitDesc.SourceString: 全队攻击带有「赤焰」的目标时，回复全队1.5%生命值，此效果冷却时间为1秒。
SuitDesc.LocalizedString: Restores 1.5% HP to allies when they attack a target with Crimson Flame. Cooldown: 1s.

SuitDesc.SourceString: 全队攻击带有「赤焰」的目标时，回复全队3%生命值，此效果冷却时间为1秒。
SuitDesc.LocalizedString: Restores 3% HP to allies when they attack a target with Crimson Flame. Cooldown: 1s.

SuitDesc.SourceString: 全队无视怪物3%的防御力。
SuitDesc.LocalizedString: Causes allies' attacks to ignore 3% of the monster's DEF.

SuitDesc.SourceString: 装备者每隔3秒，对大范围内目标施加「白焰圣火」，此效果后台生效。
SuitDesc.LocalizedString: Applies White Lightflame to targets in a large area every 3s, even while the wearer is off-field.

SuitDesc.SourceString: 全队的攻击力提升15%。
SuitDesc.LocalizedString: Increases allies' ATK by 15%.

SuitDesc.SourceString: 装备者身上的「赤焰」不会消失；释放变轨技能时，同步全队成员与范围内目标的「白焰圣火」最高层数。
SuitDesc.LocalizedString: Prevents the wearer's Crimson Flame from disappearing. Casting a Redirect Skill synchronizes White Lightflame stacks among all allies and targets within range, matching them to the highest current stack count.

SuitDesc.SourceString: 装备者受到的「赤焰」伤害降低40%；处于前台时，防御力提升250%，攻击力提升450%。
SuitDesc.LocalizedString: Reduces the wearer's Crimson Flame DMG taken by 40%. While the wearer is active, increases DEF by 250% and ATK by 450%.

SuitDesc.SourceString: 装备者受到的「赤焰」伤害降低80%；处于前台时，防御力提升500%，攻击力提升900%。
SuitDesc.LocalizedString: Reduces the wearer's Crimson Flame DMG taken by 80%. While the wearer is active, increases DEF by 500% and ATK by 900%.

SuitDesc.SourceString: 全队的暴击伤害提升13.5%。
SuitDesc.LocalizedString: Increases allies' Crit DMG by 13.5%.

SuitDesc.SourceString: 全队施加的「白焰圣火」可蔓延至相邻目标。
SuitDesc.LocalizedString: Allows White Lightflame inflicted by allies to spread to nearby targets.

SuitDesc.SourceString: 真红受到的「赤焰」伤害降低40%；驻场时，抗打断能力提升，防御力提升400%。
SuitDesc.LocalizedString: Reduces Crimson Flame DMG taken by Shinku by 40%. While active, increases Resistance to Interruptions and increases DEF by 400%.

SuitDesc.SourceString: 真红受到的「赤焰」伤害降低80%；驻场时，抗打断能力提升，防御力提升800%。
SuitDesc.LocalizedString: Reduces Crimson Flame DMG taken by Shinku by 80%. While active, increases Resistance to Interruptions and increases DEF by 800%.

SuitDesc.SourceString: 全队攻击带有「赤焰」的目标时，暴击伤害提升300%。
SuitDesc.LocalizedString: Increases allies' Crit DMG by 300% when they attack targets marked with Crimson Flame.

SuitDesc.SourceString: 全队攻击带有「赤焰」的目标时，暴击伤害提升600%。
SuitDesc.LocalizedString: Increases allies' Crit DMG by 600% when they attack targets marked with Crimson Flame.

SuitDesc.SourceString: 全队引爆「蚀焰印记」时，每有1个「蚀焰印记」的目标，引爆伤害提升40%。
SuitDesc.LocalizedString: Increases Detonation DMG by 40% for each target with Eclipseflame Mark when allies trigger its detonation.

SuitDesc.SourceString: 全队引爆「蚀焰印记」时，每有1个「蚀焰印记」的目标，引爆伤害提升100%。
SuitDesc.LocalizedString: Increases Detonation DMG by 100% for each target with Eclipseflame Mark when allies trigger its detonation.

SuitDesc.SourceString: 全队的伤害提升14% 。
SuitDesc.LocalizedString: Increases allies' DMG dealt by 14%.

SuitDesc.SourceString: 全队为已有「蚀焰印记」的目标再次施加「蚀焰印记」时，额外附加1个减益效果。
SuitDesc.LocalizedString: Inflicts 1 additional debuff when an ally reapplies Eclipseflame Mark to a target already affected by it.

SuitDesc.SourceString: 装备者受到的「赤焰」伤害降低40%；处于前台时，防御力提升250%，攻击力提升450%。
SuitDesc.LocalizedString: Reduces the wearer's Crimson Flame DMG taken by 40%. While the wearer is active, increases DEF by 250% and ATK by 450%.

SuitDesc.SourceString: 装备者受到的「赤焰」伤害降低80%；处于前台时，防御力提升500%，攻击力提升900%。
SuitDesc.LocalizedString: Reduces the wearer's Crimson Flame DMG taken by 80%. While the wearer is active, increases DEF by 500% and ATK by 900%.

SuitDesc.SourceString: 全队施加的「蚀焰印记」击杀目标时，为其相邻目标施加「蚀焰印记」，并使接下来5秒内的引爆伤害提升150%。
SuitDesc.LocalizedString: Applies Eclipseflame Mark to nearby targets when a target with Eclipseflame Mark inflicted by allies is defeated. Increases detonation DMG by 150% for the next 5s.

SuitDesc.SourceString: 全队施加的「蚀焰印记」击杀目标时，为其相邻目标施加「蚀焰印记」，并使接下来5秒内的引爆伤害提升300%。
SuitDesc.LocalizedString: Applies Eclipseflame Mark to nearby targets when a target with Eclipseflame Mark inflicted by allies is defeated. Increases detonation DMG by 300% for the next 5s.

SuitDesc.SourceString:
零的所有攻击会给目标施加「梦羊」，每层「梦羊」会额外减少怪物1.8%的抗性。
初始「梦羊」：怪物抗性减少5%，持续2秒，至多叠加5层。
SuitDesc.LocalizedString:
Causes all of Esper Zero's attacks to inflict Dreamwool on the target. Each stack of Dreamwool additionally reduces the monster's Resistance by 1.8%.
Default Dreamwool: Reduces the monster's Resistance by 5% for 2s, up to 5 stacks.

SuitDesc.SourceString: 每层「梦羊」会额外减少怪物3.2%的抗性。
SuitDesc.LocalizedString: Each stack of Dreamwool additionally reduces the monster's Resistance by 3.2%.

SuitDesc.SourceString:
伊洛伊小羊们的攻击有25%的几率会给目标施加「梦羊」 ，同时每只小羊施加「梦羊」时会造成额外200%倍率的伤害 。
初始「梦羊」：怪物抗性减少5%，持续2秒，至多叠加5层。
SuitDesc.LocalizedString:
There's a 25% chance that attacks from Iroi's sheep inflict Dreamwool on the target. Each sheep deals 200% additional DMG when inflicting Dreamwool.
Default Dreamwool: Reduces the monster's Resistance by 5% for 2s, up to 5 stacks.

SuitDesc.SourceString: 概率提升至75%，伤害倍率提升至200%。
SuitDesc.LocalizedString: Increases the chance to 75% and the DMG Ratio to 200%.

SuitDesc.SourceString: 队伍中角色对挂有「梦羊」的目标施加攻击时，有20%的几率给全队施加「牧歌」：暴击伤害提升40%，持续3秒，至多叠加3层。
SuitDesc.LocalizedString: There's a 20% chance to apply Pastorale to all allies when an ally attacks a target with Dreamwool. Pastorale Effect: Increases Crit DMG by 40% for 3s, up to 3 stacks.

SuitDesc.SourceString: 「牧歌」施加的暴击伤害提升至120%。
SuitDesc.LocalizedString: Increases the Crit DMG bonus granted by Pastorale to 120%.

SuitDesc.SourceString: 方塔苏斯普攻间隔减少0.8秒，普攻倍率增加600%。
SuitDesc.LocalizedString: Reduces Phantasos's Basic Attack interval by 0.8s and increases its Basic Attack Ratio by 600%.

SuitDesc.SourceString: 方塔苏斯普攻间隔减少1.2秒，普攻倍率增加2000%。
SuitDesc.LocalizedString: Reduces Phantasos's Basic Attack interval by 1.2s and increases its Basic Attack Ratio by 2,000%.

SuitDesc.SourceString: 队伍中角色击杀带有「梦羊」的目标的敌人后，有30%的几率给全队施加「引光」：暴击提升3%，持续3秒，至多叠加3层。
SuitDesc.LocalizedString: There's a 30% chance to apply Lightcalling to allies when an ally defeats a target with Dreamwool. Lightcalling Effect: Increases Crit Chance by 3% for 3s, up to 3 stacks.

SuitDesc.SourceString: 「引光」施加的暴击提升提升至10%。
SuitDesc.LocalizedString: Increases the Crit Chance bonus granted by Lightcalling to 10%.

SuitDesc.SourceString: 队伍中角色受到治疗时，有30%的几率给该角色施加「曦风」：伤害提升50%，持续5秒，至多叠加3层。
SuitDesc.LocalizedString: There's a 30% chance to apply Dawnwind to an ally when they are healed. Dawnwind Effect: Increases DMG dealt by 50% for 5s, up to 3 stacks.

SuitDesc.SourceString: 概率提升至50%，且「曦风」还会使攻击力60%，暴击伤害提升100%。
SuitDesc.LocalizedString: Increases the chance to 50%. Dawnwind also increases ATK by 60% and Crit DMG by 100%.

SuitDesc.SourceString:
真红大招、技能和极限闪避为目标施加「梦羊」，「梦羊」的持续时间增加1秒，每层额外减少怪物1%的抗性。
初始「梦羊」：怪物抗性减少5%，持续2秒，至多叠加5层。
SuitDesc.LocalizedString:
Applies Dreamwool to targets when Shinku uses her Ultimate, Skill, or Critical Dodge. Increases Dreamwool's duration by 1s. Each stack additionally reduces the monster's Resistance by 1%.
Default Dreamwool: Reduces the monster's Resistance by 5% for 2s, up to 5 stacks.

SuitDesc.SourceString: 「梦羊」的持续时间增加2秒，每层额外减少怪物2%的抗性。
SuitDesc.LocalizedString: Increases Dreamwool's duration by 2s. Each stack additionally reduces the monster's Resistance by 2%.

SuitDesc.SourceString:
薄荷释放大招和长按普攻「梦羊」，「梦羊」的持续时间增加1秒，每层额外减少怪物1%的抗性。
初始「梦羊」：怪物抗性减少5%，持续2秒，至多叠加5层。
SuitDesc.LocalizedString:
Applies Dreamwool to targets when Mint uses her Ultimate and charged Basic Attacks. Increases Dreamwool's duration by 1s. Each stack additionally reduces the monster's Resistance by 1%.
Default Dreamwool: Reduces the monster's Resistance by 5% for 2s, up to 5 stacks.

SuitDesc.SourceString: 「梦羊」的持续时间增加2秒，每层额外减少怪物2%的抗性。
SuitDesc.LocalizedString: Increases Dreamwool's duration by 2s. Each stack additionally reduces the monster's Resistance by 2%.

SuitDesc.SourceString: 队伍中角色对挂有「梦羊」的目标施加攻击时，有10%的几率给全队施加「夜曲」：伤害提升21%，持续3秒，至多叠加2层。
SuitDesc.LocalizedString: There's a 10% chance to apply Nocturne to all allies when an ally attacks a target with Dreamwool. Nocturne Effect: Increases DMG dealt by 21% for 3s, up to 2 stacks.

SuitDesc.SourceString: 「夜曲」施加的伤害提升提升至40%。
SuitDesc.LocalizedString: Increases the DMG bonus granted by Nocturne to 40%.

SuitDesc.SourceString: 莫尔甫斯普攻间隔减少0.4秒，普攻倍率增加200%
SuitDesc.LocalizedString: Reduces Morpheus's Basic Attack interval by 0.4s and increases its Basic Attack Ratio by 200%.

SuitDesc.SourceString: 莫尔甫斯普攻间隔减少0.6秒，普攻倍率增加500%
SuitDesc.LocalizedString: Reduces Morpheus's Basic Attack interval by 0.6s and increases its Basic Attack Ratio by 500%.

SuitDesc.SourceString: 队伍中角色对带有「梦羊」的目标的敌人造成暴击后，有20%的几率给全队施加「坠星」：攻击力提升25%，持续3秒，至多叠加3层。
SuitDesc.LocalizedString: There's a 20% chance to apply Falling Star to allies when an ally lands a Critical Hit on a target with Dreamwool. Falling Star Effect: Increases ATK by 25% for 3s, up to 3 stacks.

SuitDesc.SourceString: 「坠星」施加的攻击力提升至75%。
SuitDesc.LocalizedString: Increases the ATK bonus granted by Falling Star to 75%.

SuitDesc.SourceString: 队伍中角色对怪物造成暴击时，有60%的几率对目标施加「猎标」：持续5秒，至多叠加10层。「猎标」达到10层或怪物死亡时，造成【250000+100000*层数】的范围伤害并清除标记。「猎标」对同一个目标1秒内只会造成1次伤害。
SuitDesc.LocalizedString: There's a 60% chance to inflict Hunter's Mark on the target for 5s when an ally lands a Critical Hit on a monster. Hunter's Mark stacks up to 10 times. Deals AoE DMG equal to (250,000 + 100,000 × stacks) and clears the mark at 10 stacks or when the monster is defeated. Hunter's Mark can damage the same target only once per second.

SuitDesc.SourceString: 「猎标」造成的爆炸的伤害提升500% 。
SuitDesc.LocalizedString: Increases Hunter's Mark explosion DMG by 500%.

SuitDesc.SourceString: 以身为剑，划破黎明。
SuitDesc.LocalizedString: With body forged as blade, cleave the coming dawn.

SuitDesc.SourceString: 要听听吗？沃伦大陆之外的歌谣。
SuitDesc.LocalizedString: Lend an ear—a ballad drifts from beyond the Warren Continent.

SuitDesc.SourceString: 自由的风，是抓不住的。
SuitDesc.LocalizedString: No chain can bind the wind of freedom.

SuitDesc.SourceString: 或许，赤龙也可以是屠龙勇士。
SuitDesc.LocalizedString: Perhaps even the Crimson Dragon may rise as a dragonslayer.

SuitDesc.SourceString: 全队的伤害提升14% 。
SuitDesc.LocalizedString: Increases allies' DMG dealt by 14%.

SuitDesc.SourceString: 食用采集物时不会受到减益效果影响。装备者受到的所有药水效果大幅提升，且药水效果持续时间延长。
SuitDesc.LocalizedString: Grants the wearer immunity to debuffs when consuming gathered items. Greatly enhances all potion effects on the wearer and extends their duration.

SuitDesc.SourceString: 全队的攻击力提升15%。
SuitDesc.LocalizedString: Increases allies' ATK by 15%.

SuitDesc.SourceString: 被变为「绵绵」的目标，抗性降低100%，持续30秒。
SuitDesc.LocalizedString: Reduces the Resistance of targets morphed into Fuzzy by 100% for 30s.

SuitDesc.SourceString: 全队的暴击伤害提升13.5%。
SuitDesc.LocalizedString: Increases allies' Crit DMG by 13.5%.

SuitDesc.SourceString: 装备者每次对目标造成伤害时，附加1层「疾风」标记。标记持续3秒，上限10层。累计至上限时清空「疾风」层数并对大范围目标造成800%倍率的伤害，此效果冷却时间为2秒。
SuitDesc.LocalizedString: Applies 1 stack of Gale Mark each time the wearer deals damage to a target. Gale Mark lasts 3s, up to 10 stacks. Clears all Gale Mark stacks when they reach the limit and deals 800% DMG to all targets in a large area. Cooldown: 2s.
